content:
Content type
Updates a logo in the Tenable MSSP Portal. This update overwrites the existing logo.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The UUID of the logo to update.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
multipart/form-data
required
string <binary>
The logo to upload. The logo must be in PNG format and no larger than
246x52 pixels.
string
An identifiable, user-defined name for the logo.
